text: The real Tasawwuf was taught by the Holy Prophet ﷺ himself to his students, the Companions.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · What is Tasawwuf

text: Allah has gifted man with immense intellectual ability and he has invented innumerable machines and gadgets to make life comfortable.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · What is Tazkiyah

text: When he was doing all of his own work, he still had time to relax and reflect, but now, after operating and maintaining these machines, he has no time left at all.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · What is Tazkiyah

text: By nature, a human being seeks and trusts the opinion of experts and specialists for his problems relating to every aspect of his life.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · What is Tazkiyah

text: The patients who cannot do any other exercise are advised to stroll in their rooms to keep their organs agile and active.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Reformation of the Heart

text: One type of fear is that of a thief or mugger; other type may be fear of disease, it can also be fear of loss in business, yet another type may be fear of something harmful like a snake.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Islam — The Religion of Love

text: Our Prophet is both a guide and a symbol of human excellence in thought and practice, and therefore he is the most beloved for all Muslims.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Love of the Holy Prophet

text: Although many Muslims may claim their allegiance to the Prophet's message, an honest evaluation of our belief and conduct reminds us that we woefully fall short of our claim.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Love of the Holy Prophet

text: The human body has a role in worldly affairs only, while the reality lies within this visible form.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Constant Zikr and the Taste of Association

text: The real human dwells inside this body, a body which is made from the earth and its clothing, food and medicines all come from the earth.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Constant Zikr and the Taste of Association

text: From here we derive a principle that, as time draws away from the Holy Prophet ﷺ its blessings decrease correspondingly.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Company of the Holy Prophet

text: The golden era, the first three centuries, also known as Khair ul Quroon was indeed a very blessed period.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Company of the Holy Prophet

text: The Barakah can be achieved with respectful volition, even if Bai'at is not taken.
attribution: Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah · Importance of Bai'at
